meta.title: Lighting The Beacon
meta.description: Banish the shroud of night and awaken the slumbering light once more.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Middle Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: May the stars cleanse you... and render you into light.
units.displayText: May the stars cleanse you... and render you into light.

spans.text: May the stars cleanse you... and render you into light.

units.rawText: Waves of starlight wash over the battlefield as Eos finishes speaking, sweeping away the Entropics before us.
units.displayText: Waves of starlight wash over the battlefield as Eos finishes speaking, sweeping away the Entropics before us.

spans.text: Waves of starlight wash over the battlefield as Eos finishes speaking, sweeping away the Entropics before us.

units.rawText: As I thought... My power doesn't seem to have recovered yet.
units.displayText: As I thought... My power doesn't seem to have recovered yet.

spans.text: As I thought... My power doesn't seem to have recovered yet.

units.rawText: It doesn't matter as long as we can complete our mission.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter as long as we can complete our mission.

spans.text: It doesn't matter as long as we can complete our mission.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, how much further until we reach our destination?
units.displayText: {교수}, how much further until we reach our destination?

spans.text: , how much further until we reach our destination?

units.rawText: A moment please. This wall will shift in 3 minutes. Our objective lies beyond.
units.displayText: A moment please. This wall will shift in 3 minutes. Our objective lies beyond.

spans.text: A moment please. This wall will shift in 3 minutes. Our objective lies beyond.

units.rawText: Understood. We'll set up camp once we reach the Watchtower and begin treating Electra.
units.displayText: Understood. We'll set up camp once we reach the Watchtower and begin treating Electra.

spans.text: Understood. We'll set up camp once we reach the Watchtower and begin treating Electra.

units.rawText: Just a while longer. We're almost there.
units.displayText: Just a while longer. We're almost there.

spans.text: Just a while longer. We're almost there.

units.rawText: After turning back to address Alcyone, she once again raises her hand and gathers operands at her fingertips.
units.displayText: After turning back to address Alcyone, she once again raises her hand and gathers operands at her fingertips.

spans.text: After turning back to address Alcyone, she once again raises her hand and gathers operands at her fingertips.

units.rawText: Eos, are you alright? You've been clearing the way for us ever since we entered the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Eos, are you alright? You've been clearing the way for us ever since we entered the Middle Ring.

spans.text: Eos, are you alright? You've been clearing the way for us ever since we entered the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: Hm? Are you worried about me, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: Hm? Are you worried about me, {교수}?

spans.text: Hm? Are you worried about me,

units.rawText: Hehe, don't worry. I've been keeping an eye on my operand expenditure. I've been maintaining an ample reserve after taking into account everyone's condition and our upcoming mission.
units.displayText: Hehe, don't worry. I've been keeping an eye on my operand expenditure. I've been maintaining an ample reserve after taking into account everyone's condition and our upcoming mission.

spans.text: Hehe, don't worry. I've been keeping an eye on my operand expenditure. I've been maintaining an ample reserve after taking into account everyone's condition and our upcoming mission.

units.rawText: I've also recovered 30% of my operands, so if you need backup, I can step in to be your frontliner anytime!
units.displayText: I've also recovered 30% of my operands, so if you need backup, I can step in to be your frontliner anytime!

spans.text: I've also recovered 30% of my operands, so if you need backup, I can step in to be your frontliner anytime!

units.rawText: Hehehe, you're so reliable, Ally. Still, it isn't yet time for you to use your strength, so just leave it to me for now.
units.displayText: Hehehe, you're so reliable, Ally. Still, it isn't yet time for you to use your strength, so just leave it to me for now.

spans.text: Hehehe, you're so reliable, Ally. Still, it isn't yet time for you to use your strength, so just leave it to me for now.

units.rawText: In turn, I'll be leaving Electra to you.
units.displayText: In turn, I'll be leaving Electra to you.

spans.text: In turn, I'll be leaving Electra to you.

units.rawText: After Eos' admonition, Alcyone nods and looks at Electra on her back.
units.displayText: After Eos' admonition, Alcyone nods and looks at Electra on her back.

spans.text: After Eos' admonition, Alcyone nods and looks at Electra on her back.

units.rawText: Due to the lack of further medical care, Electra is currently running on low-power mode, drifting in and out of consciousness.
units.displayText: Due to the lack of further medical care, Electra is currently running on low-power mode, drifting in and out of consciousness.

spans.text: Due to the lack of further medical care, Electra is currently running on low-power mode, drifting in and out of consciousness.

units.rawText: I understand. I'll take good care of her.
units.displayText: I understand. I'll take good care of her.

spans.text: I understand. I'll take good care of her.

units.rawText: Rumblerumblerumble—
units.displayText: Rumblerumblerumble—

spans.text: Rumblerumblerumble—

units.rawText: There is a dull grinding sound as the labyrinth walls shift once again.
units.displayText: There is a dull grinding sound as the labyrinth walls shift once again.

spans.text: There is a dull grinding sound as the labyrinth walls shift once again.

units.rawText: By the time the walls stop moving, a towering structure appears before our eyes.
units.displayText: By the time the walls stop moving, a towering structure appears before our eyes.

spans.text: By the time the walls stop moving, a towering structure appears before our eyes.

units.rawText: This structure looks clearly out of place compared to the surrounding environment, and there are white walls vaguely visible below the purple organic growths covering it.
units.displayText: This structure looks clearly out of place compared to the surrounding environment, and there are white walls vaguely visible below the purple organic growths covering it.

spans.text: This structure looks clearly out of place compared to the surrounding environment, and there are white walls vaguely visible below the purple organic growths covering it.

units.rawText: ...Is this another Watchtower?
units.displayText: ...Is this another Watchtower?

spans.text: ...Is this another Watchtower?

units.rawText: Indeed. This is our objective in the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Indeed. This is our objective in the Middle Ring.

spans.text: Indeed. This is our objective in the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: Although there are many Low-Order Entropics roaming the interior of the Watchtower, Eos disposes of them within a few minutes.
units.displayText: Although there are many Low-Order Entropics roaming the interior of the Watchtower, Eos disposes of them within a few minutes.

spans.text: Although there are many Low-Order Entropics roaming the interior of the Watchtower, Eos disposes of them within a few minutes.

units.rawText: This Watchtower...
units.displayText: This Watchtower...

spans.text: This Watchtower...

units.rawText: An Entropic that was lying on the ground suddenly lunges at me, but it is obliterated by a ray of golden light.
units.displayText: An Entropic that was lying on the ground suddenly lunges at me, but it is obliterated by a ray of golden light.

spans.text: An Entropic that was lying on the ground suddenly lunges at me, but it is obliterated by a ray of golden light.

units.rawText: Hm? Should I have minded my own business?
units.displayText: Hm? Should I have minded my own business?

spans.text: Hm? Should I have minded my own business?

units.rawText: Eos laughs as she stands down.
units.displayText: Eos laughs as she stands down.

spans.text: Eos laughs as she stands down.

units.rawText: Still, you seem to be staring really hard at this place... Did you find something?
units.displayText: Still, you seem to be staring really hard at this place... Did you find something?

spans.text: Still, you seem to be staring really hard at this place... Did you find something?

units.rawText: I gently brush away the marks that the Entropy virus has left on the Watchtower.
units.displayText: I gently brush away the marks that the Entropy virus has left on the Watchtower.

spans.text: I gently brush away the marks that the Entropy virus has left on the Watchtower.

units.rawText: <cmdr>?
units.displayText: {교수}?

units.rawText: I had my suspicions earlier when I obtained the Rubik's Map.
units.displayText: I had my suspicions earlier when I obtained the Rubik's Map.

spans.text: I had my suspicions earlier when I obtained the Rubik's Map.

units.rawText: The interior structure of this Watchtower is too plain.
units.displayText: The interior structure of this Watchtower is too plain.

spans.text: The interior structure of this Watchtower is too plain.

units.rawText: Hm? What do you mean?
units.displayText: Hm? What do you mean?

spans.text: Hm? What do you mean?

units.rawText: ...I think what <cmdr> means is that while this looks like a complete Watchtower from the outside, its interior design is extremely simple.
units.displayText: ...I think what {교수} means is that while this looks like a complete Watchtower from the outside, its interior design is extremely simple.

spans.text: ...I think what
means is that while this looks like a complete Watchtower from the outside, its interior design is extremely simple.

units.rawText: It's nothing like what we usually see in our Watchtowers...
units.displayText: It's nothing like what we usually see in our Watchtowers...

spans.text: It's nothing like what we usually see in our Watchtowers...

units.rawText: Rather than a simple design, it's more like there were hardly any adornments... as though they were never planned in the first place.
units.displayText: Rather than a simple design, it's more like there were hardly any adornments... as though they were never planned in the first place.

spans.text: Rather than a simple design, it's more like there were hardly any adornments... as though they were never planned in the first place.

units.rawText: After all, this Watchtower was not built recently. Rather, it was left behind from the war between the first generation of Sanctifiers and the Entropics.
units.displayText: After all, this Watchtower was not built recently. Rather, it was left behind from the war between the first generation of Sanctifiers and the Entropics.

spans.text: After all, this Watchtower was not built recently. Rather, it was left behind from the war between the first generation of Sanctifiers and the Entropics.

units.rawText: Eosphorus takes Electra from Alcyone's back, clears some space, and envelopes her in warm operands.
units.displayText: Eosphorus takes Electra from Alcyone's back, clears some space, and envelopes her in warm operands.

spans.text: Eosphorus takes Electra from Alcyone's back, clears some space, and envelopes her in warm operands.

units.rawText: Don't worry. This Watchtower is largely functional and can serve as a base of operations. All we need to do now is repair the device and then we can continue the treatment.
units.displayText: Don't worry. This Watchtower is largely functional and can serve as a base of operations. All we need to do now is repair the device and then we can continue the treatment.

spans.text: Don't worry. This Watchtower is largely functional and can serve as a base of operations. All we need to do now is repair the device and then we can continue the treatment.

units.rawText: After looking at Electra's calm, even breathing and her gentle sleeping face, Alcyone breathes a quiet sigh of relief.
units.displayText: After looking at Electra's calm, even breathing and her gentle sleeping face, Alcyone breathes a quiet sigh of relief.

spans.text: After looking at Electra's calm, even breathing and her gentle sleeping face, Alcyone breathes a quiet sigh of relief.

units.rawText: ...So, are all these Sanctifier artifacts only found in Tartarus?
units.displayText: ...So, are all these Sanctifier artifacts only found in Tartarus?

spans.text: ...So, are all these Sanctifier artifacts only found in Tartarus?

units.rawText: I'm talking about the map, the relic you and Eos found, as well as the place we're standing in right now.
units.displayText: I'm talking about the map, the relic you and Eos found, as well as the place we're standing in right now.

spans.text: I'm talking about the map, the relic you and Eos found, as well as the place we're standing in right now.

units.rawText: Now that you mention it, this is the first time I learned we Sanctifiers ventured so deep into Tartarus before.
units.displayText: Now that you mention it, this is the first time I learned we Sanctifiers ventured so deep into Tartarus before.

spans.text: Now that you mention it, this is the first time I learned we Sanctifiers ventured so deep into Tartarus before.

units.rawText: As for the first Sanctifiers... The Pantheon doesn't say much about them.
units.displayText: As for the first Sanctifiers... The Pantheon doesn't say much about them.

spans.text: As for the first Sanctifiers... The Pantheon doesn't say much about them.

units.rawText: The first Sanctifiers followed the dictates of the gods and successfully invaded the Tartarus Sector, their blades aimed at the throne of Malkira.
units.displayText: The first Sanctifiers followed the dictates of the gods and successfully invaded the Tartarus Sector, their blades aimed at the throne of Malkira.

spans.text: The first Sanctifiers followed the dictates of the gods and successfully invaded the Tartarus Sector, their blades aimed at the throne of Malkira.

units.rawText: But they still failed in the end?
units.displayText: But they still failed in the end?

spans.text: But they still failed in the end?

units.rawText: Yes. Unfortunately, the holy texts do not record the reason for their failure. However... They pointed out two vital clues for us.
units.displayText: Yes. Unfortunately, the holy texts do not record the reason for their failure. However... They pointed out two vital clues for us.

spans.text: Yes. Unfortunately, the holy texts do not record the reason for their failure. However... They pointed out two vital clues for us.

units.rawText: The first is the relic I hold. The second are the Watchtowers in the Middle Ring of Tartarus.
units.displayText: The first is the relic I hold. The second are the Watchtowers in the Middle Ring of Tartarus.

spans.text: The first is the relic I hold. The second are the Watchtowers in the Middle Ring of Tartarus.

units.rawText: These Watchtowers are not just facilities from which frontline battles were waged, but also vital weapons that the first Sanctifiers left us.
units.displayText: These Watchtowers are not just facilities from which frontline battles were waged, but also vital weapons that the first Sanctifiers left us.

spans.text: These Watchtowers are not just facilities from which frontline battles were waged, but also vital weapons that the first Sanctifiers left us.

units.rawText: ...Could it be... These Watchtowers can deploy "halos"?
units.displayText: ...Could it be... These Watchtowers can deploy "halos"?

spans.text: ...Could it be... These Watchtowers can deploy "halos"?

units.rawText: Eosphorus nods in response to Eos.
units.displayText: Eosphorus nods in response to Eos.

spans.text: Eosphorus nods in response to Eos.

units.rawText: Yes. Once we activate the towers, they will generate halos that suppress the Entropy virus. Although, it would be easier to demonstrate rather than explain it to you.
units.displayText: Yes. Once we activate the towers, they will generate halos that suppress the Entropy virus. Although, it would be easier to demonstrate rather than explain it to you.

spans.text: Yes. Once we activate the towers, they will generate halos that suppress the Entropy virus. Although, it would be easier to demonstrate rather than explain it to you.

units.rawText: You're up, <cmdr>. Everyone else, stay alert!
units.displayText: You're up, {교수}. Everyone else, stay alert!

spans.text: You're up,
. Everyone else, stay alert!

units.rawText: Eosphorus stands in the center of the Watchtower and ushers me over, inviting me to work the control dais.
units.displayText: Eosphorus stands in the center of the Watchtower and ushers me over, inviting me to work the control dais.

spans.text: Eosphorus stands in the center of the Watchtower and ushers me over, inviting me to work the control dais.

units.rawText: The central control terminal...
units.displayText: The central control terminal...

spans.text: The central control terminal...

units.rawText: The core control terminal for the Sanctifier Watchtower is covered by Entropic corrosion, but the damage is only surface-level and has not reached the device's interior.
units.displayText: The core control terminal for the Sanctifier Watchtower is covered by Entropic corrosion, but the damage is only surface-level and has not reached the device's interior.

spans.text: The core control terminal for the Sanctifier Watchtower is covered by Entropic corrosion, but the damage is only surface-level and has not reached the device's interior.

units.rawText: I extend a hand and infuse my operands into it. As the core control terminal powers back up again, information about this Watchtower appears in my mind.
units.displayText: I extend a hand and infuse my operands into it. As the core control terminal powers back up again, information about this Watchtower appears in my mind.

spans.text: I extend a hand and infuse my operands into it. As the core control terminal powers back up again, information about this Watchtower appears in my mind.

units.rawText: ([objectTower_b2] ...Is that the name of this Watchtower?)
units.displayText: [objectTower_b2] ...Is that the name of this Watchtower?

spans.text: [objectTower_b2] ...Is that the name of this Watchtower?

units.rawText: What's wrong, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: What's wrong, {교수}?

spans.text: What's wrong,

units.rawText: Much of the information contained within this Watchtower is blanked out, but the key portions are intact.
units.displayText: Much of the information contained within this Watchtower is blanked out, but the key portions are intact.

spans.text: Much of the information contained within this Watchtower is blanked out, but the key portions are intact.

units.rawText: Deploying the Halo requires authorization from a Greater Sanctifier, but nothing else.
units.displayText: Deploying the Halo requires authorization from a Greater Sanctifier, but nothing else.

spans.text: Deploying the Halo requires authorization from a Greater Sanctifier, but nothing else.

units.rawText: Then without further ado, please go ahead, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Then without further ado, please go ahead, {교수}.

spans.text: Then without further ado, please go ahead,

units.rawText: I'll go look around outside.
units.displayText: I'll go look around outside.

spans.text: I'll go look around outside.

units.rawText: Eos slowly flies outside the Watchtower, gesturing for us to begin.
units.displayText: Eos slowly flies outside the Watchtower, gesturing for us to begin.

spans.text: Eos slowly flies outside the Watchtower, gesturing for us to begin.

units.rawText: Activating objectTower_b2, initiating Sanctifier_Eliminate protocol. Please enter command.
units.displayText: Activating objectTower_b2, initiating Sanctifier_Eliminate protocol. Please enter command.

spans.text: Activating objectTower_b2, initiating Sanctifier_Eliminate protocol. Please enter command.

units.rawText: Activate Halo.
units.displayText: Activate Halo.

spans.text: Activate Halo.

units.rawText: Command confirmed. Requester name: <cmdr>. Access granted. objectTower_b2 now deploying Halo, deploying spoof data...
units.displayText: Command confirmed. Requester name: {교수}. Access granted. objectTower_b2 now deploying Halo, deploying spoof data...

spans.text: Command confirmed. Requester name:
. Access granted. objectTower_b2 now deploying Halo, deploying spoof data...

units.rawText: As a mechanical voice reels off notification after notification, circular ripples of white spread from the center of the Watchtower.
units.displayText: As a mechanical voice reels off notification after notification, circular ripples of white spread from the center of the Watchtower.

spans.text: As a mechanical voice reels off notification after notification, circular ripples of white spread from the center of the Watchtower.

units.rawText:
The ground beneath my feet lurches, and the Watchtower growls.
My whole body is caught in the grip of this bass resonance, but it doesn't cause us any harm.
units.displayText:
The ground beneath my feet lurches, and the Watchtower growls.
My whole body is caught in the grip of this bass resonance, but it doesn't cause us any harm.

spans.text:
The ground beneath my feet lurches, and the Watchtower growls.
My whole body is caught in the grip of this bass resonance, but it doesn't cause us any harm.

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeepbeep—

units.rawText: Eos, how are things?
units.displayText: Eos, how are things?

spans.text: Eos, how are things?

units.rawText: The Entropics caught in the Halo are moving much more slowly than before. They're trying to escape the Halo's radius.
units.displayText: The Entropics caught in the Halo are moving much more slowly than before. They're trying to escape the Halo's radius.

spans.text: The Entropics caught in the Halo are moving much more slowly than before. They're trying to escape the Halo's radius.

units.rawText: Through the communications window, we see Eos effortlessly wiping out several Low-Order Entropics. Some of them are directly melting in the Halo.
units.displayText: Through the communications window, we see Eos effortlessly wiping out several Low-Order Entropics. Some of them are directly melting in the Halo.

spans.text: Through the communications window, we see Eos effortlessly wiping out several Low-Order Entropics. Some of them are directly melting in the Halo.

units.rawText: It seems the activation was successful, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: It seems the activation was successful, Eosphorus.

spans.text: It seems the activation was successful, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: This is great!
units.displayText: This is great!

spans.text: This is great!

units.rawText: This might be the best news we've heard ever since we ventured into Tartarus. Even the otherwise melancholic Alcyone is clapping in excitement.
units.displayText: This might be the best news we've heard ever since we ventured into Tartarus. Even the otherwise melancholic Alcyone is clapping in excitement.

spans.text: This might be the best news we've heard ever since we ventured into Tartarus. Even the otherwise melancholic Alcyone is clapping in excitement.

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus?

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Our wish...
units.displayText: Our wish...

spans.text: Our wish...

units.rawText: Eosphorus takes a deep breath and composes himself.
units.displayText: Eosphorus takes a deep breath and composes himself.

spans.text: Eosphorus takes a deep breath and composes himself.

units.rawText: Since we've confirmed that the Halos exist, and that they have a suppressive effect on the Entropics...
units.displayText: Since we've confirmed that the Halos exist, and that they have a suppressive effect on the Entropics...

spans.text: Since we've confirmed that the Halos exist, and that they have a suppressive effect on the Entropics...

units.rawText: Then it is time for us to strike back and cleanse these Daemons. All Sanctifiers, take heed.
units.displayText: Then it is time for us to strike back and cleanse these Daemons. All Sanctifiers, take heed.

spans.text: Then it is time for us to strike back and cleanse these Daemons. All Sanctifiers, take heed.

units.rawText: Alcyone, you will hold this Watchtower and ensure the safety of this Halo.
units.displayText: Alcyone, you will hold this Watchtower and ensure the safety of this Halo.

spans.text: Alcyone, you will hold this Watchtower and ensure the safety of this Halo.

units.rawText: You will also be in charge of Electra's treatment.
units.displayText: You will also be in charge of Electra's treatment.

spans.text: You will also be in charge of Electra's treatment.

units.rawText: Ah... Got it!
units.displayText: Ah... Got it!

spans.text: Ah... Got it!

units.rawText: Then where will the rest of you go?
units.displayText: Then where will the rest of you go?

spans.text: Then where will the rest of you go?

units.rawText: If I'm not wrong, there is more than one Watchtower here.
units.displayText: If I'm not wrong, there is more than one Watchtower here.

spans.text: If I'm not wrong, there is more than one Watchtower here.

units.rawText: Well-spotted. What you saw was nothing more than a fraction of the Halo's power. There are three Sanctifier Watchtowers in Tartarus' Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Well-spotted. What you saw was nothing more than a fraction of the Halo's power. There are three Sanctifier Watchtowers in Tartarus' Middle Ring.

spans.text: Well-spotted. What you saw was nothing more than a fraction of the Halo's power. There are three Sanctifier Watchtowers in Tartarus' Middle Ring.

units.rawText: If we activate all three of them at once, a complete Halo will be generated, capable of suppressing or even destroying all the Entropics in Tartarus' Middle Ring.
units.displayText: If we activate all three of them at once, a complete Halo will be generated, capable of suppressing or even destroying all the Entropics in Tartarus' Middle Ring.

spans.text: If we activate all three of them at once, a complete Halo will be generated, capable of suppressing or even destroying all the Entropics in Tartarus' Middle Ring.

units.rawText: It might even be able to affect the Inner Ring... And the Throne of Malkira.
units.displayText: It might even be able to affect the Inner Ring... And the Throne of Malkira.

spans.text: It might even be able to affect the Inner Ring... And the Throne of Malkira.

units.rawText: The first Sanctifiers sure were amazing... I can't believe they left such a powerful weapon for us...
units.displayText: The first Sanctifiers sure were amazing... I can't believe they left such a powerful weapon for us...

spans.text: The first Sanctifiers sure were amazing... I can't believe they left such a powerful weapon for us...

units.rawText: But if this information falls into the hands of the enemy...
units.displayText: But if this information falls into the hands of the enemy...

spans.text: But if this information falls into the hands of the enemy...

units.rawText: Eos has returned to us at some point. She floats serenely in mid-air, awaiting Eosphorus' command.
units.displayText: Eos has returned to us at some point. She floats serenely in mid-air, awaiting Eosphorus' command.

spans.text: Eos has returned to us at some point. She floats serenely in mid-air, awaiting Eosphorus' command.

units.rawText: Indeed. That's why I have kept it secret all this time.
units.displayText: Indeed. That's why I have kept it secret all this time.

spans.text: Indeed. That's why I have kept it secret all this time.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, do you have any questions?
units.displayText: {교수}, do you have any questions?

spans.text: , do you have any questions?

options.rawText: What exactly happened to the first Sanctifiers that made them unable to conquer the Tartarus Sector?
options.displayText: What exactly happened to the first Sanctifiers that made them unable to conquer the Tartarus Sector?

spans.text: What exactly happened to the first Sanctifiers that made them unable to conquer the Tartarus Sector?

options.rawText: Did the first Sanctifiers mention anything about their strength being sapped?
options.displayText: Did the first Sanctifiers mention anything about their strength being sapped?

spans.text: Did the first Sanctifiers mention anything about their strength being sapped?

units.rawText: Did they still fail even after coming so far?
units.displayText: Did they still fail even after coming so far?

spans.text: Did they still fail even after coming so far?

units.rawText: The holy texts do not record this... I find it most vexing, too.
units.displayText: The holy texts do not record this... I find it most vexing, too.

spans.text: The holy texts do not record this... I find it most vexing, too.

units.rawText: Otherwise, it would be hard to explain why they failed to succeed even after coming this far.
units.displayText: Otherwise, it would be hard to explain why they failed to succeed even after coming this far.

spans.text: Otherwise, it would be hard to explain why they failed to succeed even after coming this far.

units.rawText: No... The holy texts do not mention it. Perhaps they encountered some other difficulty. Or perhaps...
units.displayText: No... The holy texts do not mention it. Perhaps they encountered some other difficulty. Or perhaps...

spans.text: No... The holy texts do not mention it. Perhaps they encountered some other difficulty. Or perhaps...

units.rawText: ...It seems we must be wary, even with the weapons of the first Sanctifiers in hand.
units.displayText: ...It seems we must be wary, even with the weapons of the first Sanctifiers in hand.

spans.text: ...It seems we must be wary, even with the weapons of the first Sanctifiers in hand.

units.rawText: Eos and <cmdr> will move together. You will handle the second Watchtower.
units.displayText: Eos and {교수} will move together. You will handle the second Watchtower.

will move together. You will handle the second Watchtower.

units.rawText: I will take care of it myself. We'll split our forces three ways and activate the Halos as quickly as possible so as to suppress the Daemons of Tartarus.

units.rawText: I know.
units.displayText: I know.

units.rawText: Hm? What were you two talking about? Did you leave me out of some discussion? How mean.

options.rawText: Eosphorus probably wants me to record the range at which the Halo weakens Entropics and whether it's effective on High-Order Entropics, right?
options.displayText: Eosphorus probably wants me to record the range at which the Halo weakens Entropics and whether it's effective on High-Order Entropics, right?

spans.text: Eosphorus probably wants me to record the range at which the Halo weakens Entropics and whether it's effective on High-Order Entropics, right?

options.rawText: Eosphorus probably wants to check if the malware inside the Rubik's Map still has an effect on us inside the Halo, right?
options.displayText: Eosphorus probably wants to check if the malware inside the Rubik's Map still has an effect on us inside the Halo, right?

spans.text: Eosphorus probably wants to check if the malware inside the Rubik's Map still has an effect on us inside the Halo, right?

units.rawText: Currently, I've only observed its effects on Low-Order Entropics within the Halo's radius... This is definitely something that is worthy of attention.
units.displayText: Currently, I've only observed its effects on Low-Order Entropics within the Halo's radius... This is definitely something that is worthy of attention.

spans.text: Currently, I've only observed its effects on Low-Order Entropics within the Halo's radius... This is definitely something that is worthy of attention.

units.rawText: ...The malware, you say...
units.displayText: ...The malware, you say...

units.rawText: Either way, it will need to be verified with live testing.
units.displayText: Either way, it will need to be verified with live testing.

spans.text: Either way, it will need to be verified with live testing.

units.rawText: Relax. <cmdr> and I will pay attention to this.

and I will pay attention to this.

units.rawText: Of course, it would be reckless to head over right away. Use the Watchtower's resources to restore yourselves and replenish your operands.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in front of the old Sanctifier Watchtower.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in front of the old Sanctifier Watchtower.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in front of the old Sanctifier Watchtower.

units.rawText: Why the grim look? Is there something you wish to say before you head out?
units.displayText: Why the grim look? Is there something you wish to say before you head out?

spans.text: Why the grim look? Is there something you wish to say before you head out?

units.rawText: Eos, <cmdr>, you will have to go deep into the Middle Ring to reach your Watchtower. Please be careful.

, you will have to go deep into the Middle Ring to reach your Watchtower. Please be careful.
